warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THE PILE ITEM (1.1) IS THE ONLY LINE THAT ACTUALLY DIFFERS FROM THE ฐานรากแผ่ SET'S STRUCTURAL SHEET. *** Everything below it -- excavation 75, sand 5, lean concrete 10, structural concrete 53, formwork 310/441/92/80, nails 110, and all five rebar diameters at IDENTICAL quantities (479/1150/568/2837/670 kg) -- is copied verbatim from the spread-footing set. That means the above-ground concrete and rebar quantities do not change between foundation scenarios; only the foundation item itself (spread footing's excavation/footing concrete vs. this set's 96 piles) differs.

PILE SPEC: 0.22 x 0.22 m square, 6.00 m long, driven ('ตอก') -- matching S-01's note '0.22×0.22 ≥3.0 ตัน/ต้น' and S-02's 'เสาเข็มคอนกรีตอัดแรง'. Each pile head is then cut/trimmed ('สกัดหัวเสาเข็ม') to receive its cap.

*** THIS 96-PILE COUNT IS THE CLEANEST CROSS-CHECK IN THE WHOLE HOUSE 07 EXTRACTION: it is derived independently on S-02 (pile_count per footing mark, verified against drawn pile symbols) and printed as a flat total here, and the two numbers agree exactly. ***

The identical excavation figure (75 ลบ.ม.) in both BOQ sets is odd on reflection -- a pile-cap foundation is normally shallower than a spread footing, so equal excavation volumes across two different foundation types is worth flagging rather than assuming is simply a copy-paste artifact of the template.
This sheet continues onto แผ่นที่ 3/34, exactly as the spread-footing set's structural category did.
